title: Theorem 2 (maindelta): multilinear Kakeya for nearly axis-parallel lines
statement_scope: Complete Theorem 2 (label maindelta): for every eps>0 there exists delta>0 such that for all n line families l_{j,a} in R^n (j=1,...,n; a=1,...,N_j) whose lines make angle at most delta with the corresponding coordinate axis, for all S>=1 and all cubes Q_S of side length S, the integral over Q_S of the product of the n tube-count functions to the power 1/(n-1) is at most C_eps S^eps times the product of N_j to the power 1/(n-1). The author proof includes both the S=delta^{-M} iteration and the arbitrary S>=1 cube-covering step.
